title: Starling OS
tagline: Command and control for the AI era
blurb: Starling structures and unifies an organization's data in one connected platform, delivering total information awareness. It gives teams a single platform to plan, execute, and measure, and the semantic layer that lets technology reason about how the organization actually operates.
bullet_points: A complete system of truth: fragmented information replaced by a shared source of clarity, so teams align around consistent definitions and data, reducing friction and accelerating execution.
Organizational ontology: define what the organization is made of (its key elements, how they connect, and where they live) in a structure everyone can see, use, and trust.

Unify and simplify: internal systems, spreadsheets, and custom inputs integrated into one consistent schema; extend the tools already in use, replace them, or build new solutions with no technical expertise required.
The foundation for AI: structured, connected data powers automations, predictions, and insights that elevate performance and decision quality.
Data sovereignty: customer data is never used, shared, or trained on, and remains fully under the organization's control.

Built for sensitive missions: configurable compartmentalization and granular, multi-dimensional access control, plus causal scenario analysis and anomaly and pattern detection for governments and agencies.

title: Sealed Secret
tagline: Prove you own it, never reveal it
blurb: Strains, sequences, recipes, and process data are often worth more kept quiet than patented. Sealed Secret anchors a one-way fingerprint of each asset to the Bitcoin blockchain, giving owners court-ready proof of what they had, and when, without the secret ever leaving their hands.
bullet_points: Seal locally: files are hashed in the owner's own environment; the original is never uploaded, shared, or stored.
Anchor to Bitcoin: the fingerprint and a precise timestamp are written to a public, immutable ledger that no one can move or rewrite.
Certificate of existence: tamper-evident proof that an asset existed, in that exact form, under that ownership, on that date.
Zero-knowledge by design: only a fingerprint is sealed, so the secret could not be disclosed even under compulsion.
Reasonable-steps evidence: a documented sealing program shows trade secrets were actively guarded, deterring misappropriation and strengthening enforcement.

title: Variable Comp & Phantom Equity Management
tagline: Pay tied to the outcomes that matter
blurb: Variable compensation and phantom equity align people with the performance of the business, but most plans live in spreadsheets that are hard to administer and harder to explain. This platform defines, tracks, and communicates incentive plans so every participant knows exactly how their work translates into reward.
bullet_points: Plans as systems: variable pay and phantom equity plans defined once, with clear, consistent, auditable rules.
Tied to real performance: payouts calculated from the metrics the business already tracks, not reconstructed at year end.
Transparent to participants: everyone can see where they stand and what moves their number, turning compensation into a daily motivator.
Retention without dilution: phantom equity gives key people a real stake in the upside without giving up actual ownership.
Ready for scrutiny: administration and reporting in one place, prepared for the board, auditors, and a future transaction.

title: Hiring for Specificity
tagline: Define the seat before you fill it
blurb: Most hiring goes wrong before the first interview, with a role that was never precisely defined. Hiring for Specificity turns a vague opening into an exact definition of the outcomes, responsibilities, and profile the seat requires, then evaluates candidates against it.
bullet_points: Vague until made precise: every role defined down to the outcomes it owns and how success is measured.
Connected to the system: each role maps to the structure, processes, and accountability around it.
Evaluated against the definition: candidates assessed on consistent, role-specific criteria instead of gut feel.
Fewer costly misses: a precisely defined seat attracts precisely matched candidates, reducing the expense of a wrong hire.
